title: Zesty Syrian Lamb Kebabs
description: A fresh and adventurous Syrian dish featuring lamb, umeboshi, and bonito flakes, perfect for those looking for a raw-friendly meal option.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, garlic, lemon juice, salt, and black pepper.
Add the lamb cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill the kebabs for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until the lamb is cooked to an internal temperature of 145 degrees.
While the kebabs are cooking, mix together umeboshi plums and bonito flakes in a small bowl.
Once the kebabs are done, brush them with the umeboshi and bonito mixture.
Serve the kebabs hot, garnished with chopped parsley.
